title: Identified animal bones from Göbekli Tepe, by species
description: Bar chart of the number of identified specimens (NISP) from the central area of Göbekli Tepe, excavations 1996–2001: goitered gazelle 7,949; aurochs 2,574; wild sheep 1,237; Asiatic wild ass 1,177; fox 971; wild boar 863; Cape hare 386; red deer 170. Data: Peters and Schmidt 2004, table 1.
heading: GÖBEKLI TEPE · IDENTIFIED BONES (NISP), 1996–2001
